scope.implemented: Startup and after-delete skill trash retention, durable pre-removal diagnostics, failure protection
scope.nextP0: FR-2 tab persistence and known-workspace entry

changes.compatibility: Existing write.ts imports re-export the moved interfaces/functions

policy.ageBasis: manifest.createdAt, consistent with timestamped batch ID
policy.order: createdAt milliseconds descending, then batchId descending
policy.budgetExceptions: Protected/untrusted/interrupted/namespace data excluded; total directories/disk can exceed budget
policy.preVisibility: Persist planned snapshot then publish diagnostic state before rm; automatic startup execution does not wait for human confirmation
policy.locks: Shared trash root lock then batch manifest lock for cooperating writers
policy.failureMode: Keep data and report when policy, audit, identity or lock cannot be trusted

guards: Strict v1 shared manifest reader; preserve unknown metadata; reject damaged/duplicate entries
Ordinary root/scope/flat-wrapper directories and registered payload roots; unregistered siblings retained
Recovery flags and outside cleanup-pending markers exclude batches and prevent blind undo/conflict restore
Policy fingerprint rechecked; invalid/unknown/linked config does not destructively fall back to 7 days
Pre-removal audit must persist before any rm; unknown/corrupt/linked audit stays unchanged
Intent file outside the batch precedes each rm; partial writes also protect by presence
Oldest reviewed candidates only; per-batch token rechecked; no unreviewed new deletions join the plan
Last actual execution retained when later inspection has no work
MCP, backups, foreign, linked batches, future dates and mismatched identities not cleaned
Root snapshot plus per-batch validation avoids quadratic rescanning

cases: age uses deletion time, includes exactly seven days, and persists the pre-delete plan
count keeps the newest 100 by precise createdAt, not random suffix ordering
MCP, unknown/corrupt/linked/future/pending/unregistered data do not enter the retention budget
planned batches changed by an external writer are skipped without creating a cleanup intent
failure to persist the pre-removal audit prevents every destructive step
corrupt, unknown-version or linked cleanup audit stays unchanged and blocks automatic deletion
partial rm failure leaves an outside intent; subsequent cleanup and undo refuse the damaged entity
partially written intent is conservative even when its JSON is invalid
final audit write failure preserves the pre-plan and reports actual removed data honestly
dispose/cancellation and changed policy after preview do not remove planned batches
a policy change during intent creation clears only its own unused intent and preserves the batch
new deletions wait for cleanup and are never added to its frozen removal plan
successful entity-link cleanup never follows or removes its external target
last persisted execution is retained when the next startup has no work
runtime startup publishes the pre-delete snapshot then removes only expired skill batches
runtime deletion cleans after adding a batch and finishes with 100 normal batches
invalid configuration never falls back to a shorter destructive retention policy
an external config change at the published startup plan stops removal
disposing the runtime from its pre-cleanup snapshot cancels all unstarted removals

uiValidation.realRuntimeInteraction: Expired fixture startup cleanup, c shows pre-plan/result, audit bytes unchanged by view; stale shared-group snapshot check retained with initialization awaited
uiValidation.method: Actual host UI rendering/stdin/SGR hit testing, no direct handler calls

realTui.restart: No new candidate; previous after-delete pre/post audit retained byte-for-byte and visible with c
realTui.preRemovalOrdering: Durable audit and live pre-delete state were asserted with the real runtime test observer while source batch still existed; real TUI verified retained history rather than a human pause

finalReleaseCheck.scope: Final stable source/tests/README; later edits only non-packed documentation/evidence

artifactRecheck.reason: Normalize one trailing blank line in the extracted module; rebuilt archive is byte-identical to the full release check

limits: Expiry/quota cleanup is permanent, cannot be undone
Invalid configuration/audit, failed cleanup and protected data can leave total storage over budget
Pending cleanup intents are not auto-cleared and need inspection; partial entities are not auto-restored
Latest actual execution persisted, not an unbounded audit history
Coarse root lock can make another cooperating writer wait or time out
No arbitrary external-writer isolation or fsync/power-loss guarantee
No automatic cleanup policy added for MCP/backup/pending metadata
Other P0, full user acceptance, layout/performance final check and external KI-01..03 remain open
